author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a clear 45-degree chevron head on a centred shaft, with the floor line detached by a full clear gap so the arrow reads as 'down to the minimum' and no longer as a three-stroke asterisk.
omissions: The source's wide wings meeting the floor line at one point were separated into a chevron tip and a floor bar, because the reviewer found the merged junction unreadable.
drawing_plan: Shaft on x=24, mirrored chevron wings of 12, floor line at the VRECT_L bottom edge.
